title: Ban duck shooting in Victoria
summary: Georgie Purcell's re-election platform commits to pushing for a ban on duck shooting in Victoria.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Ban duck shooting in Victoria and finally end the annual slaughter of native waterbirds.

title: Overhaul wildlife control permits and strengthen the Wildlife Act
summary: The party would push to overhaul the Authority to Control Wildlife permit system with greater transparency, strengthen the Wildlife Act, end the commercial killing of kangaroos, and end indiscriminate 1080 poisoning.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Overhaul Victoria’s secretive wildlife slaughter permit system, including greater transparency around who is authorised to kill wildlife, how many animals can be killed and why.

title: Implement wildlife roadstrike inquiry recommendations
summary: The party would push for full implementation of the 2025 Inquiry into Wildlife Roadstrike recommendations, including a voluntary $2 contribution for wildlife rescuers collected through vehicle registration.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Implement the full recommendations of the 2025 Inquiry into Wildlife Roadstrike report, including a voluntary $2 contribution for our wildlife rescuers collected through vehicle registration.

title: "Veticare": subsidised vet care for eligible Victorians
summary: The party proposes "Veticare", a Medicare-style scheme with subsidised vet appointments for eligible Victorians, not-for-profit vet clinics in areas of need, travelling vet services, wildlife hospitals and vet hotlines.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Subsidised vet appointments for eligible Victorians.

title: Support the veterinary workforce, including extra mental health sessions
summary: The party would push for incentives to attract vets to regional Victoria, electronic prescribing for vets, reimbursement of vets' wildlife treatment costs, and five additional funded mental health appointments for vets and vet nurses.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Provide 5 additional fully funded mental health appointments per person for veterinarians and veterinary nurses, on top of existing Medicare-subsidised sessions.

title: Replace the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act
summary: The party would push to replace the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act with a new Animal Care and Protection Act, increase cruelty penalties and create dedicated animal cruelty enforcement officers.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Replace the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act with a new Animal Care and Protection Act – just as the government promised to do ten years ago.

title: Independent Animal Welfare Agency and CCTV in slaughterhouses
summary: The party proposes an Independent Animal Welfare Agency to oversee and investigate systemic failures, and mandatory CCTV in slaughterhouses and intensive farms with regulator access to footage.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Require CCTV in slaughterhouses and intensive farming facilities, with appropriate independent oversight and access to footage for regulators.

title: Farm animal welfare: ban sow stalls, end male chick culling
summary: The party would push the government to act on the Inquiry into Pig Welfare recommendations, including banning sow stalls and moving away from pig gassing, end live lamb cutting, and support alternatives to killing male chicks such as in-ovo sexing.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Ensure the government acts on the recommendations it supported from the Inquiry into Pig Welfare in Victoria, including banning sow stalls and transitioning away from pig gassing.

title: Statewide ban on the retail sale of fur
summary: The party would push for a statewide ban on the retail sale of fur in Victoria, citing cases of mislabelled fur products sold in the state.
sourceTitle: Victoria: LOVE ANIMALS, BAN FUR!
excerpt: Add your name to call for a statewide ban on the sale of fur in Victoria – and tell the Minister for Consumer Affairs that Victorians have waited long enough for real action.

title: Ban greyhound racing and end jumps racing
summary: The party would push to ban greyhound racing, end jumps racing, ban the whip in horse racing and close loopholes allowing racing greyhounds to be exported, with transition support for affected workers and communities.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: End jumps racing and bring Victoria into line with every other Australian jurisdiction.

title: End public funding for animal racing and redirect it to services
summary: The party proposes defunding all forms of animal racing and redirecting the money to other services; it claims a $3 billion saving. Separately, it cites a PBO analysis it commissioned finding over $450 million could be saved across ten years by ending greyhound racing subsidies.
costing: Party claims $3bn saving from defunding all animal racing; PBO analysis commissioned by the party: over $450m over ten years from ending greyhound racing subsidies
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Save $3bn by defunding all forms of animal racing and redirecting the funds towards vital services that help all Victorians.

title: Stop killing of healthy shelter animals and close puppy farm loopholes
summary: The party would push to stop the killing of healthy animals in pounds and shelters, close puppy farm permit loopholes, reopen regional shelters, expand desexing vouchers and fund rescue groups.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Close puppy farm law loopholes that allow large-scaled breeders to operate under a permit system.

title: Allow pets on public transport
summary: The party would push to allow animals to travel on public transport, and to allow pet greyhounds in off-leash areas.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Allow animals to travel on public transport to make it easier for people to move around with their pets.

title: Five-year guaranteed funding for family violence services
summary: The party would push for guaranteed five-year funding for frontline family and domestic violence services, a Minister for Gender Equity, pre-recorded evidence for sexual offence complainants, and anti-SLAPP legislation.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Properly and sustainably fund frontline domestic and family violence services under a guaranteed 5-year funding model.

title: Free abortion care and end hospital "conscientious objection"
summary: The party would push to make abortion care free and accessible, including for people without Medicare, and to stop publicly funded hospitals refusing to provide reproductive health services.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Make abortion care free and accessible, including for people without Medicare.

title: Women's health: pain inquiry recommendations and midwifery care
summary: The party would push to implement all recommendations of the Inquiry into Women's Pain, expand midwifery continuity-of-care programs, and fund women's health clinics under a guaranteed five-year model.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Expand midwifery continuity of care programs across Victoria, ensuring new parents receive consistent support before, during and after pregnancy.

title: Decriminalise cannabis and raise the age of criminal responsibility to 14
summary: The party would push to decriminalise cannabis with a public health response to drug use, raise the age of criminal responsibility to 14, and end imprisonment for unpaid fines.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Decriminalise cannabis and ensure a public health response to drug use and intoxication.

title: Expand pill testing and build a second supervised injecting room
summary: The party would push to expand pill testing at more festivals and events and to build a second medically supervised injecting room, as recommended by Ken Lay.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Build a second medically supervised injecting room, as recommended by Ken Lay AO.

title: Great Forest National Park and a legislated native logging ban
summary: The party would push to establish the Great Forest National Park and legislate an outright ban on native forest logging on public and private land, and to close what it describes as loopholes allowing tree removal under fire-management programs.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Legislate an outright ban on native forest logging, on both public and private land.

title: Transparency and species surveys for public-land tree-felling
summary: The party calls for transparency over Forest Fire Management Victoria's tree-felling and timber removal on public land, mandatory threatened-species surveys for significant operations, and stronger Conservation Regulator oversight.
sourceTitle: Close the loopholes. Protect our forests. Protect our wildlife.
excerpt: Extend mandatory on-the-ground threatened-species surveys to all significant tree-felling operations on public land.

title: Transition to plant-based farming and end offshore oil and gas drilling
summary: The party would push to support farmers transitioning from animal-based to plant-based farming, invest in cultivated and plant-based meat, end offshore oil and gas drilling, and legislate a climate duty of care for children and young people.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: End all offshore oil and gas drilling and support the transition to renewable energy.

title: Oppose urban growth boundary expansion; wildlife in planning decisions
summary: The party would oppose any increase to Melbourne's urban growth boundary, strengthen green wedge protections, require wildlife impacts to be considered in planning decisions, and let councils reject developments such as AI data centres and factory farms.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Fight any attempt to increase Melbourne’s urban growth boundary and always support policy which slows the pace of sprawl.

title: Establish an Independent Police Ombudsman
summary: The party would push to establish an Independent Police Ombudsman, continue strengthening integrity laws and properly resource integrity agencies.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Establish an Independent Police Ombudsman.

title: Implement Yoorrook Justice Commission recommendations
summary: The party supports implementing all Yoorrook Justice Commission recommendations, including moving prison healthcare from the Department of Corrections to the Department of Health.
sourceTitle: Georgie Purcell's Election Platform – A Better World for Animals, People, Planet
excerpt: Support the implementation of all recommendations made by The Yoorrook Justice Commission.
